notes: Copy of the warehouse stop_name (GTFS stop_name). Used for name and intersection evidence.
Copy of the warehouse stop_desc (GTFS stop_desc).
Copy of the warehouse tts_stop_name (GTFS text-to-speech name).
Copy of the warehouse stop_code (public-facing GTFS stop code).
Copy of the warehouse stop_id (the agency's GTFS stop_id).
Warehouse feed name (human-readable feed label). Keys agency_aliases.csv and the regional-feed exclusion. Not the same as feed_key.
Plain-text reasons behind the QA status.
Y when the record is in at least one scored cross-agency pair within the candidate_max_ft envelope (300 ft). A candidate only; it does not confirm a shared stop.
Shared-stop group ID (SSG_ plus a hash of the member source keys). Records join a group through pairs that can connect. A group does not by itself confirm one physical stop.
Group-level recommendation after cross-agency coherence and conflict checks.
Plain-language confidence for the group or record (for example High, Review, Low / Caution, Conflict). A heuristic, not a probability.
Highest pair score involving this record.
Number of scored cross-agency pairs involving this record within the candidate_max_ft envelope (300 ft).
Distance in feet to the nearest other-agency record among this record's scored pairs.
agency_name (the toolkit's normalized agency label) of the record in this record's highest-scoring pair.
field_alias: Shared Stop Best Match Agency Name

notes: source_key of the record in this record's highest-scoring pair.
field_alias: Shared Stop Best Match Source Key

notes: Short summary of the best pair's classification and evidence, plus the group review reason when the record is in a group.
Hard physical-separation conflict codes from this record's pairs or group (for example opposite direction).
Number of distinct operators in the record's group, or among the record and its pair partners when it is not in a group.
The toolkit's agency/operator label: warehouse analysis_name after agency_aliases.csv is applied. Not the GTFS agency.txt agency_name.
Optional warehouse field: number of records sharing the exact same coordinates. Pair scoring adds a caution at large_exact_group_caution_size; if the field is absent, 1 is assumed.
Copy of the warehouse platform_code (GTFS platform_code). Used as platform evidence.
Copy of the warehouse parent_station (GTFS parent_station). Compared only within the same feed.
Copy of the warehouse location_type (GTFS location_type).
Stable record key used by every step: the pair-file key when the stop appears in a nearby pair, otherwise WH_ plus a hash of the stop's warehouse identifiers.
Copy of the warehouse stop_lat (GTFS latitude).
Copy of the warehouse stop_lon (GTFS longitude).
